text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon welcomed Manhattan Cafe's 
entry into the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems this upcoming Yayoi Sho holds 
significant meaning for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Manhattan Cafe had her sights set only 
on getting closer to the "friend" who lay 
beyond Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having pushed herself to the point of 
haggard exhaustion... Manhattan Cafe's 
all-out race begins.
